scene: 22:14 on a quiet Thursday, one batch run through both panes. The reader goes up to check a line, comes back down to the newest one by dragging the bar, goes up again, and the console clears the pane for the next incident. The plain pane in the left column ran the same script and its trace is beside this one, together with the order the badge above it went in, how many times it changed, and how often anyone pressed Follow.
